about_the_game:
Alchemist's Way DLC is a reliable support for novice craftsmen. Use the stabilizers and get a 100% chance of creating items in an Alchemy Cauldron!

A pack for novice alchemists and craftsmen. Stabilizers will help you avoid failures while crafting items, making the process more reliable and predictable. Start your journey in alchemy!

Contains:

·    Reaction Stabilizer (×10)
Increases the chance of successfully crafting an item in an Alchemy Cauldron to 100%

Create with confidence!

All items are linked to the account and cannot be transferred or sold. After purchase, this DLC will appear in your Golden Chest on the character selection screen.
